Definition: to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for
BiblicalUsage: 1) to see, behold, observe, regard; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to behold, observe; 1a2) to regard; 1a3) to watch, watch (stealthily), lie in wait
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
